title: glosa neighbour table row
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements templates/knowledge/neighbour_table.md and design/S13_neighbour-table.md (founder ruling 31d/31e, chair ruling A2): descriptive comparison, no priority/novelty contest. Wording rule: comparison is same/different/cited by default; `relation: adopted_from` is legal ONLY when a human explicitly instructed adoption (a Blackbox Note line or DECISIONS.yaml id required) -- AI-detected similarity is never 'adopted'. Every row needs a citation_card id with metadata_verified + claim_match_verified. Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

relation.description: Descriptive comparison vocabulary. 'adopted_from' requires adoption_authorization below (founder ruling 31g-31i).

adoption_authorization.description: Required, non-null, when relation == adopted_from -- a Blackbox Note line or DECISIONS.yaml row id that named the adoption explicitly.

tier.description: finite_diagnostic if fetched & verified; Open if not fetched (template's own rule) -- schema restricts to those two, since a neighbour-table row is never asserted at a higher tier than that.

allOf.description: tier finite_diagnostic requires both verification booleans true (fetched & verified).
